scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @gametrust/shared build && pnpm --filter @gametrust/api build && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @gametrust/shared build && pnpm --filter @gametrust/api build && pnpm --filter @gametrust/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @gametrust/shared build && pnpm --filter @gametrust/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @gametrust/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @gametrust/shared build && pnpm --filter @gametrust/shared test && pnpm --filter @gametrust/api test && pnpm --filter @gametrust/web test
